description: Sixpence, and the leaf it lacks

participation.context: Checked the lack, paid sixpence, and took the book.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Stood in the churchyard and did not speak.
participation.name: John Harrison

story.body: You saw the missing leaf, paid sixpence, and left with the worn copy. Harrison did not speak.

title: Paid sixpence for the leaves that remained

description: The first couplet, and no notes yet

participation.context: Read the couplet and did not begin the notes.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the first couplet and left the blank leaf blank.

title: Read the opening couplet

participation.context: Made the Verona page and did not turn it into a scene.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Sat on the book while the page was written.
participation.name: Gib

story.body: You copied the two couplets, struck two names, left the days blank, and stopped at the King coming first. You wrote only the sixpence for the book. You did not write a speech.

participation.context: Looked at the page and did not shift the cat.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You looked at the open poem, the notes, and the grey flank across the page.

title: Left the cat where he had sat
